name: Yasien Ghalwash
title: Ph.D. Student, Information Technology
introduction:
I am a Ph.D. student in Information Technology at the Queensland University of Technology (QUT) in Brisbane, Australia. I am supervised by Prof. Raja Jurdak and Dr. Sara Khalifa.

Currently, my doctoral thesis focuses on "Rethinking Energy Harvesters as Sensors: A New Paradigm for Continuous Motion Tracking." I am exploring how to leverage wearable solar harvesters to achieve continuous and energy-efficient tracking capabilities.

I previously graduated with a BSc in Biomedical Engineering from Cairo University, where I gained a strong foundation in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Digital Signal Processing, and Embedded Systems.
